stem.text: A light source consists of a vertical slit illuminated by red light (R) and violet light (V). The wavelength of R is approximately twice the wavelength of V. A parallel vertical double slit is placed nearby. A white screen is placed so that fringes are formed on it.

stem.alt: Diagram of a light source, a vertical slit, a vertical double slit and a white screen, in a row along a dashed horizontal line. Labels: light source, slit, double slit, white screen.

stem.text: Which graph best represents the interference fringes formed on the screen?

A.alt: Graph of intensity against distance showing a row of evenly spaced peaks labelled alternately R and V, with the peaks of equal height.

B.alt: Graph of intensity against distance showing peaks of differing widths and heights, labelled R and V.

C.alt: Graph of intensity against distance showing two sets of overlapping curves, with peaks labelled R and V.

D.alt: Graph of intensity against distance showing two sets of overlapping curves, with peaks labelled R and V.
